role: Dumps the world the integrated server holds right after initialWorldChunkLoad and before its first tick, in Snapshot's format plus animals.jsonl (the worldgen-spawned entities reduced to class, id, uuid, pose, motion and Det Random state): the reference for the native seed-world build.
used_by: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Main.java --spawndump DIR (called from Oracle.preTick at tick 0)
make -C oracle run CLASS=SpawnDump (the generic {"cmd":"run","class":"SpawnDump"} reflection dispatch in Oracle.java)
notes: No oracle/src hook; the call site is Oracle.java's preTick in the harness.
